cohort: The study included singleton neonates born at 22-29 weeks' gestation with no major anomalies, who were admitted to a NICU and discharged between 2000 and 2014.
finding: In the propensity score-matched cohort, outborn extremely preterm neonates were less likely to die in-hospital but experienced higher rates of necrotising enterocolitis, severe intraventricular haemorrhage, retinopathy of prematurity requiring treatment, and chronic lung disease compared to inborn neonates.
